The SEO Framework - Extension Manager Codebase Map
====================================================

WordPress plugin extending The SEO Framework with additional SEO features.
Manages extension activation, licensing, and provides shared infrastructure for extensions.
Requires PHP 7.4+, WordPress 6.7+, The SEO Framework 4.2.8+. Text domain: the-seo-framework-extension-manager.

Files named index.php are direct-access guards (empty PHP files).
Files ending in .min.js or .min.css are minified mirrors of their source counterparts.


Root
----
.editorconfig                   Editor config: tabs (4-wide), LF endings, final newline
.gitattributes                  Line-ending normalization, binary markers, export-ignore rules for dev files
.gitignore                      Ignores archives, logs, local data, OS artifacts
the-seo-framework-extension-manager.php   Main plugin file: header metadata, version/DB constants, loads bootstrap chain
composer.json                   Composer manifest: PHP/WP dependencies and dev tooling
cspell.json                     CSpell dictionary with project-specific allowed words
index.php                       Empty direct-access guard
license.txt                     GNU General Public License v3
phpcs.xml                       PHP_CodeSniffer ruleset for the TSFEM coding standard
README.md                       Minimal readme linking to the Extension Manager overview page
readme.txt                      WordPress.org plugin readme (description, FAQ, installation, changelog)
security.txt                    Security disclosure info pointing to GitHub Security Advisories
TODOS                           Developer-facing roadmap and known issues (future cleanup, API changes, extension plans)

.github/
	codemap.txt                   This file
	CONTRIBUTING.md               Contribution guidelines
	copilot-instructions.md       Repository coding standards and conventions for AI assistants
	ISSUE_TEMPLATE/               Issue templates for bugs, enhancements, feature requests, support, and security


Bootstrap (bootstrap/)
----------------------
Initialization sequence: main plugin file loads define.php, API functions, update.php,
troy-notice.php (admin only), and load.php. load.php hooks into init to verify TSF presence,
run upgrades, register the autoloader, and instantiate the plugin facade.

define.php                      Defines all environmental constants: paths, option keys, URIs, capability roles, API config, bitmask flags
load.php                        Core loader: hooks init to check TSF presence, register autoloader, run upgrades, protect options, instantiate plugin
install-tsf.php                 Admin nag/installer for The SEO Framework when not installed; uses Shiny Updates for AJAX plugin install
troy-notice.php                 Handles Troy Client migration notice cleanup when Troy Client is detected
update.php                      Plugin self-updater: checks dl.theseoframework.com for updates, injects into plugins_api and update transients
upgrade.php                     Database migration runner: registers version-specific upgrade callbacks for the Upgrader class
upgrader.class.php              Upgrader class: manages plugin and extension DB migrations, version tracking per member, sequential callback execution


Classes (inc/classes/)
----------------------
Core class hierarchy (admin): Core > API > Panes > AccountActivation > AdminPages > LoadAdmin
Core class hierarchy (front): Core > LoadFront
Secure_Abstract family: Secure_Abstract > Extensions, Layout, SecureOption, AJAX
All classes use the TSF_Extension_Manager namespace.

abstract/
	secure.abstract.class.php     Abstract singleton base providing secure nonce and instance verification for sensitive operations

core.class.php                  Core plugin class: nonce handling, option management, error reporting; uses Options and Error traits
alias.class.php                 Empty stub class absorbing method calls when the plugin has died; all magic methods return null/false
api.class.php                   API communication for license activation, deactivation, and status checks against the remote server
ajax.class.php                  AJAX handler for account activation/deactivation, extension toggling, and extension settings updates
extensions.class.php            Extension listing, activation, deactivation, and layout rendering with secure instance verification
extensionsettings.class.php     Extension settings layout: registers settings pages, handles form output, sanitization, and defaults
adminpages.class.php            Registers admin menu pages and initializes admin-page-specific WordPress actions
accountactivation.class.php     License activation/deactivation workflows: remote listener, form-based, free activation, domain transfer
formfieldparser.class.php       Utility for parsing HTML form field structures to/from PHP arrays (multidimensional key conversion)
formgenerator.class.php         Generates HTML settings forms for extensions from structured schema definitions with nested iteration
html.class.php                  Static HTML utility: tooltips, question-mark help icons, dropdown option lists
inpostgui.class.php             Registers and outputs in-post editor GUI elements (tabs, fields, nonces) for extensions
inposthtml.class.php            Static utility for wrapping inpost GUI elements in flex-based HTML structures
layout.class.php                Outputs layout elements (forms, links, lists) via secure abstract verification pattern
listedit.class.php              Registers and renders quick-edit and bulk-edit GUI elements for extensions in post list tables
loadadmin.class.php             Admin facade: bootstraps activation notices, API checks, constant-based activation, POST handling, AJAX
loadfront.class.php             Front-end facade: minimal class extending Core with empty constructor
panes.class.php                 Renders the extensions overview pane: account info, domain transfer, upgrade forms, extension listing
schemapacker.class.php          Packs Schema.org JSON-LD structured data from user input using schema layout definitions
secureoption.class.php          Verifies option update operations via instance-based verification on pre_update_option filters


Traits (inc/traits/)
--------------------
Shared trait files used across the plugin and extensions.

core/
	error.trait.php               Error notice storage, retrieval, formatting, and dismissible admin display
	overload.trait.php            15 traits enforcing class instantiation patterns (singleton, static-only, final, facade, visibility)
	ui.trait.php                  Admin page UI: script/style initialization, page layout wrappers, header/pane/footer rendering

extension/
	forms.trait.php               HTML form field generation helpers for extensions: field names, IDs, nonces, submit/action buttons
	options.trait.php             Per-extension options CRUD stored in a shared WP option, with stale (non-autoloaded) option support
	post-meta.trait.php           Per-extension post metadata CRUD stored in a single serialized post meta key
	views.trait.php               Secure view-file inclusion mechanism for extensions with shared secret validation

factory/
	memory.trait.php              Memory limit management: reads PHP memory limit, can increase it, checks free memory availability
	time.trait.php                I18n-aware time formatting: human-readable "time ago", rectified dates, time-unit scaling

manager/
	extensions-layout.trait.php   Extension list UI rendering: icons, about sections, activation buttons, compatibility indicators
	extensions.trait.php          Master extension registry, activation/deactivation logic, checksum validation, compatibility checks
	options.trait.php             Core site options management with irreversible per-request caching and instance-based verification


Functions (inc/functions/)
--------------------------
api.php                         Public API entry points: tsf_extension_manager()/tsfem() accessors, capability checks, trait/compat loaders, bootstrap timer, path utilities
transition.php                  TSF v4/v5 compatibility shim functions bridging API differences; removed once TSF v5.0+ is minimum


Compatibility (inc/compat/)
---------------------------
Currently empty directory (index.php guard only).


Views (views/)
--------------
PHP view templates rendered by admin pages and UI components.

forms/
	free.php                      POST form for activating the free/no-license-key mode
	get.php                       Stub form template for external signup redirect (unused)
	key.php                       POST form with license key and email inputs for premium API key activation

layout/
	general/
		footer.php                Branded page footer with randomly selected positive motto
		pane.php                  Reusable collapsible/movable pane wrapper with configurable size, logo, AJAX container
		top.php                   Top header bar with page title, account/license link, and About popover
	pages/
		activation.php            Plugin activation page with sections for API key, license key, and free activation
		extensions.php            Extensions management page composing the overview and account/actions panes
		symbols.php               Hidden SVG symbol sheet containing all extension logo icons for inline use
	extension/
		content.php               Iterates registered extension settings and renders each as a pane with a form
		footer.php                Branded footer for the Extension Settings page
		pane.php                  Individual extension settings pane containing a dynamically generated form
		top.php                   Header with TSF logo and "Extension Settings" title

listedit/
	bulk.php                      Fieldset sections for WordPress bulk-edit, iterating registered extension sections
	quick.php                     Fieldset sections for WordPress quick-edit, iterating registered extension sections

template/
	fbtopnotice.php               JS template for a fallback top-of-page error notice
	inpostnotice.php              JS templates for inpost dismissible notices (5xx errors, updates, warnings, errors)


JavaScript (lib/js/)
--------------------
Client-side scripts for admin interfaces. Each .js file has a corresponding .min.js minified version.

tsfem.js                        Core JS module: shared utilities, AJAX nonces, DOM helpers, common functions across all TSFEM pages
tsfem-form.js                   Dynamic extension settings form generation, iteration, collapsible fields, AJAX submission
tsfem-inpost.js                 Inpost extension UI: AJAX save/load of extension meta, tabs, notices, premium state
tsfem-listedit.js               Post list table quick-edit and bulk-edit integration, restoring inline extension field values
tsfem-manager.js                Extension Manager main page: extension activation/deactivation toggles and UI interactions
tsfem-ui.js                     Shared manager UI components: switcher buttons, modal dialogs, AJAX loaders, notifications
tsfem-worker.js                 Web Worker management API: spawning, messaging, and tracking background workers for extensions
tsfinstaller.js                 Hooks into WordPress plugin updater to handle installing/activating TSF from within TSFEM


CSS (lib/css/)
--------------
Stylesheets for admin interfaces. Each .css file has a corresponding .min.css minified version.

tsfem-form.css                  Extension settings form UI: collapsible sections, multi-setting inputs, form layout
tsfem-inpost.css                Inpost extension UI: notification areas, dashicon status icons, flex wrappers
tsfem-manager.css               Extensions overview/manager page: extension entry cards, layout, grid spacing
tsfem-ui.css                    Core UI: normalization, notice styling, layout structure, general component theming


Images (lib/images/)
--------------------
exticon-fallback.svg            Fallback icon for extensions without a custom icon
tsflogo.svg                     The SEO Framework logo used in admin page headers


Language (language/)
--------------------
the-seo-framework-extension-manager.pot   POT translation template for the the-seo-framework-extension-manager text domain


Extensions (extensions/)
========================
Extensions are organized by tier: essentials (bundled), free, and premium.
Each extension has an assets/ directory (icon, index guard) and a trunk/ directory
containing the extension code. Extensions follow a common pattern: a bootstrap PHP file
defining constants and loading context-specific classes (admin/front/sitemap).


Essentials Extensions
---------------------

Articles (extensions/essentials/articles/)
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Adds Article structured data (JSON-LD) and a Google News sitemap to posts.

trunk/
	articles.php                  Bootstrap: defines version/path constants, loads admin/front/sitemap classes
	readme.md                     Extension readme
	test.json                     Test configuration for extension validation
	inc/classes/
		core.class.php            Base class with post-meta and extension-options traits
		admin.class.php           Admin: extension settings UI, sitemap registry integration, extension views
		front.class.php           Front: outputs Article JSON-LD structured data on posts (AMP and non-AMP)
		sitemap.class.php         Registers and manages the Google News sitemap endpoint via TSF's sitemap registry
		sitemapbuilder.class.php  Builds the Google News XML sitemap output, extending TSF's sitemap builder
	lib/images/
		icon.svg                  Extension icon
	views/
		inpost/
			inpost.php            Inpost meta box fields for article type (NewsArticle, BlogPosting) and genre selection
		list/
			quickedit.php         Quick-edit inline select for article structured data type
			bulkedit.php          Bulk-edit inline select for article structured data type
		sitemap/
			news.php              Google News XML sitemap output template

Cord (extensions/essentials/cord/)
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Connects a site to third-party analytics services (Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, etc.).

trunk/
	cord.php                      Bootstrap: defines constants, loads admin/front classes
	readme.md                     Extension readme
	test.json                     Test configuration for extension validation
	inc/classes/
		core.class.php            Base class with extension-options trait for tracking configuration
		admin.class.php           Admin: settings page for configuring tracking IDs and analytics options
		front.class.php           Front: outputs tracking scripts on the front end based on stored options
	lib/images/
		icon.svg                  Extension icon (also icon-29x29px.png, icon-58x58px.png raster versions)

Focus (extensions/essentials/focus/)
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Guides content writing with focus keywords, inflections, synonyms, and SEO scoring.

trunk/
	focus.php                     Bootstrap: defines constants, loads admin/ajax classes
	readme.md                     Extension readme
	test.json                     Test configuration for extension validation
	inc/classes/
		core.class.php            Base class with post-meta trait for keyword/scoring storage, default lexical forms
		admin.class.php           Admin: renders focus keyword analysis UI in the post editor, loads views
		ajax.class.php            AJAX: handles API requests for keyword analysis data with secure key verification
		scoring.class.php         Scoring template and evaluation logic for focus keyword analysis
	lib/
		css/
			tsfem-focus-inpost.css          Styles for the Focus inpost keyword analysis UI
		js/
			tsfem-focus-inpost.js           Keyword interpretation, scoring display, and inpost UI logic
			tsfem-focus-parser.worker.js    Web Worker for background content parsing (inflections, synonyms)
	views/inpost/
		inpost.php                Main inpost view: focus keyword input fields and scoring/audit UI
		focus-template.php        Collapsible focus keyword analysis panel template
		score-template.php        Individual scoring criteria template
		js-templates.php          JS script templates for dynamic focus UI elements

Honeypot (extensions/essentials/honeypot/)
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Catches comment and WooCommerce checkout spam using six lightweight honeypot methods.
Context-aware via CONTEXT_SUPPORTS constant (comments, woocommerce-checkout).

trunk/
	honeypot.php                  Bootstrap: defines constants, loads front class
	readme.md                     Extension readme
	inc/classes/
		front.class.php           Front: implements honeypot spam-catching logic with dynamic validation, hidden fields
	js.js                         Inline JS: hides the honeypot trap field and clears its value for real users
	timer.js                      Inline JS: timer-based honeypot detecting bots that submit too quickly


Free Extensions
---------------

AMP (extensions/free/amp/)
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Binds TSF's SEO output to AMP plugin pages.

trunk/
	amp.php                       Bootstrap: defines constants, loads front class
	readme.md                     Extension readme
	inc/classes/
		front.class.php           Front: hooks into amp_post_template_head to output TSF meta tags on AMP pages

Incognito (extensions/free/incognito/)
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Hides all TSF development indicators from HTML output.

trunk/
	incognito.php                 Single-file extension: removes HTML comments, title indicator, sitemap attribution

Origin (extensions/free/origin/)
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Redirects attachment pages to their parent post or file URL.

trunk/
	origin.php                    Single-file extension: performs 301 redirects from attachment pages

Title Fix (extensions/free/title-fix/)
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Ensures HTML title output matches TSF's configuration when themes handle it incorrectly.

trunk/
	title-fix.php                 Bootstrap: defines constants, loads front class
	readme.md                     Extension readme
	inc/classes/
		front.class.php           Front: uses output buffering to capture and replace the title tag with TSF's

Transport (extensions/free/transport/)
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Migrates SEO metadata from other plugins (Yoast, Rank Math, SEOPress) into TSF.

trunk/
	transport.php                 Bootstrap: defines constants, loads admin class (beta)
	readme.md                     Extension readme
	test.json                     Test configuration for extension validation
	inc/classes/
		admin.class.php           Admin: import UI with plugin selection and import controls, headless mode check
		handler.class.php         Executes import/migration callbacks with memory management for large batches
		importers/
			core.class.php        Abstract core importer: defines conversion schema (from/to fields, transformers)
			postmeta/
				base.class.php              Abstract base for post meta importers, configured for postmeta table
				seo-by-rank-math.class.php  Rank Math post meta importer
				wordpress-seo.class.php     Yoast SEO post meta importer
				wp-seopress.class.php       SEOPress post meta importer
			termmeta/
				base.class.php              Abstract base for term meta importers, configured for termmeta table
				seo-by-rank-math.class.php  Rank Math term meta importer
				wordpress-seo.class.php     Yoast SEO term meta importer
				wp-seopress.class.php       SEOPress term meta importer
		transformers/
			core.class.php        Abstract core transformer: data sanitization methods converting source values to TSF format
			seo-by-rank-math.class.php  Rank Math data transformers
			wordpress-seo.class.php     Yoast SEO data transformers
			wp-seopress.class.php       SEOPress data transformers
		logger/
			store.class.php       In-memory logging store with unique identifier for tracking import operations
			server.class.php      Streaming log output to the client during import with support detection
	lib/
		images/
			icon.svg              Extension icon
		js/
			tsfem-transport.js    Transport admin UI: plugin selection, import controls, progress display
			sse.worker.js         Server-Sent Events worker for streaming import progress
	views/layout/
		general/
			top.php               Transport page header
			footer.php            Transport page footer
		pages/
			transport.php         Main transport page layout
		panes/
			importer.php          Import configuration and execution pane
			logger.php            Import log display pane


Premium Extensions
------------------

Local (extensions/premium/local/)
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Outputs Local Business structured data (Schema.org JSON-LD) for search engines.

trunk/
	local.php                     Bootstrap: defines constants and own DB version, loads admin/front classes
	readme.md                     Extension readme
	test.json                     Test configuration for extension validation
	upgrade.php                   Database schema upgrades for the Local extension (versioned migration callbacks)
	inc/
		classes/
			core.class.php        Base class with extension-options trait for local business configuration
			admin.class.php       Admin: registers Local admin page with headless mode support
			front.class.php       Front: outputs Local Business JSON-LD via the_seo_framework_after_meta_output
			fields.class.php      All Local Business form field templates based on Google's structured data spec
			settings.class.php    Secure POST processing, error handling, and settings UI for Local
		traits/
			schema-packer.trait.php   Schema.org JSON-LD packing/serialization logic with float precision handling
			secure-post.trait.php     Secure POST request handling: nonce verification, capability checks, sanitization
	lib/
		images/
			icon.svg              Extension icon (also icon-29x29px.png, icon-58x58px.png raster versions)
		js/
			tsfem-local.js        Local admin UI: settings form interaction and dynamic field handling
		schema/
			schema.json           JSON definition of schema.org field hierarchy, types, and conditional handlers
	views/layout/
		general/
			top.php               Local page header
			footer.php            Local page footer
		pages/
			local.php             Main Local page layout
			settings.php          Local settings page layout

Monitor (extensions/premium/monitor/)
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Tracks website SEO optimizations and statistics via an external monitoring service.

trunk/
	monitor.php                   Bootstrap: defines constants, loads admin/front classes
	readme.md                     Extension readme
	test.json                     Test configuration for extension validation
	inc/classes/
		admin.class.php           Admin: Monitor page, API key verification, connection management, data display
		api.class.php             API communication with the Monitor service, request handling, integrity verification
		data.class.php            Monitor data management (options/transients) with class integrity verification
		front.class.php           Front: placeholder class with empty constructor (no current front-end output)
		output.class.php          Parses Monitor data into HTML pane overviews for the admin dashboard
		tests.class.php           Evaluates Monitor data against SEO criteria with markdown-formatted output
	lib/
		css/
			tsfem-monitor.css     Styles for the Monitor admin dashboard
		images/
			icon.svg              Extension icon (also icon-29x29px.png, icon-58x58px.png raster versions)
		js/
			tsfem-monitor.js      Monitor admin UI: dashboard interaction, data refresh, connection controls
	views/
		forms/
			connect.php           Monitor service connection form
		layout/
			general/
				top.php           Monitor page header
				footer.php        Monitor page footer
			pages/
				connect.php       Monitor connection page layout
				monitor.php       Main Monitor dashboard page layout
